issue.title: Suppress or fix LoadWithBase dispatch error for repos using harness base composition

llm_context.input_title: Suppress or fix LoadWithBase dispatch error for repos using harness base composition
llm_context.input_body: No body provided in issue description.

generated_output.summary: On PR dispatches for repositories using harness base composition (such as a base field in review.yaml pointing to a remote template), the fullsend harness dispatch logs an error stating that the harness was not loaded with LoadWithBase. Even though the review agent falls back and executes successfully, this creates persistent log noise during PR runs.
generated_output.root_cause_analysis: The CLI dispatch command code path that loads harness configurations for agent routing fails to use the `LoadWithBase` function required when a harness config specifies a `base:` field for composition.

step_by_step_plan.title: Inspect Harness Dispatch Loading Logic
step_by_step_plan.description: Inspect symbol Dispatch in internal/harnessdispatch/core.go to locate where harness configurations are initially loaded before agent execution.

step_by_step_plan.title: Update Configuration Loading to Support Base Composition
step_by_step_plan.description: Modify the harness loading routine in internal/harnessdispatch/core.go to utilize LoadWithBase (or equivalent base composition support) instead of standard loading when a base configuration field is present.

step_by_step_plan.title: Add or Update Regression Test in core_test.go
step_by_step_plan.description: Add a test case in internal/harnessdispatch/core_test.go simulating a harness configuration using a remote or local base field, asserting that dispatch loads successfully without triggering base composition log errors.

step_by_step_plan.title: Run Test Suite
step_by_step_plan.description: Execute the package test suite to verify that the harness dispatch fix resolves the log noise and does not break existing agent execution paths.

structured_concepts.short_explanation: A feature allowing configuration files (harnesses) to inherit from or compose with a base configuration template.
structured_concepts.why_it_matters: Enables modular reuse of agent configurations across repositories without duplicating common workflow settings.
structured_concepts.connection_to_issue: Repos utilizing this composition feature trigger an error during dispatch because the loading mechanism expects a specialized load function (`LoadWithBase`).

structured_concepts.short_explanation: Categorizing runtime messages by severity to prevent unnecessary alarms for non-fatal fallback paths.
structured_concepts.why_it_matters: Proper log levels ensure that real failures stand out and are not obscured by routine fallback warnings.
structured_concepts.connection_to_issue: The issue notes that since the review agent still executes successfully via fallback, logging at error level creates unnecessary noise that could mask genuine issues.

common_pitfalls: Changing configuration loading behavior globally without accounting for org-mode versus per-repo mode differences.
Introducing import cycles between the config package and harness or dispatch packages.
